description: Use this to answer on a thread the user already holds, with the key they hold. Send the user's own words: this tool does not compose messages on their behalf, and nothing is sent until they have seen the exact text. The call is staged: a dry run sends nothing, and the confirmed call is bound to the exact payload that dry run returned. Call once with dry_run=true to get the exact payload and a confirmation_token; call again with the same arguments plus that token to send. A token that does not match the payload is refused and nothing is sent.

confirmation_token.description: The token from the dry run, for the confirmed send.

dry_run.description: true returns the exact text and a confirmation_token, and sends nothing.

key.description: The msgid / answer key of the thread.

replies_to.description: Optional id of the message being answered.

request_id.description: Your own idempotency key for this reply.

text.description: The reply, in the user's own words. Required.

name: reply_to_exchange
title: Reply on your exchange thread
